verdicts.reason: Both make the same structural mistakes. The subhead is squeezed into a narrow left column and wraps to 7 lines at nearly headline size, so it competes with the headline. The YEARLY card has shrunk below the other two, which kills the emphasis it had in the original. The legal text is unreadably tiny. The left column is also cramped against the canvas edge. A puts the CTA level with the top of the cards, which leaves it floating with dead space below. B centres the CTA beside the card row, which groups it a bit better, but B's subhead almost touches the MONTHLY card.
